name: Ring of Bleeding Wounds
body:
Aura strong conjuration; CL 15th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of regeneration but once the wearer is injured the ring shows its true nature. All wounds received by the wearer takes on the bleed condition, each wound inflicting an additional 1 point of damage each round until a successful DC 15 Heal check is made or the wearer receives some form of curative magic. This bleed damage does stack.

This ring cannot be removed unless remove curse is cast on the wearer followed by a heal cast upon the ring. Doing so destroys the ring, which dissolves into a mass of coagulated blood.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of regeneration

Identification DC 40
False Identification DC 30
